import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path
from mcp import Client, StdioServerParameters
from mcp.client.stdio import stdio_client

ROOT = Path('/tmp/codenib-codegraph-benefit-g0/guard-workflow')
REPO = ROOT / 'repository'
SOURCE = Path('/home/zhongming/CodeNib-codegraph-benefit')
PYTHON = '/home/zhongming/.venvs/codenib/bin/python'
ROOT.mkdir()
REPO.mkdir()
env = dict(os.environ, CODENIB_HOME=str(ROOT / 'state'), CODENIB_TOOLCHAIN_DIR='/home/zhongming/.codenib/toolchains', CODENIB_FIXTURE_CLIENT_STATE=str(ROOT / 'clients.json'), PYTHONPATH=str(SOURCE))
env['PATH'] = '/tmp/codenib-codegraph-benefit-g0/bin:/home/zhongming/.venvs/codenib/bin:/home/zhongming/.local/bin:' + os.environ['PATH']
rows = []

def save(row):
    rows.append(row)
    (ROOT / 'receipts.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2))
    print(json.dumps({k: row[k] for k in ('phase','returncode','seconds','nodes','source_unchanged') if k in row}), flush=True)

def snapshot():
    return {str(p.relative_to(REPO)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in REPO.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '.git' not in p.relative_to(REPO).parts}

def command(phase, arguments, *, check=True):
    start = time.monotonic()
    result = subprocess.run(arguments, cwd=REPO, env=env, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=120)
    save(dict(phase=phase, argv=arguments, seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3), returncode=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr))
    if check and result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(result.stdout + result.stderr)
    return result

CLI = [PYTHON, '-m', 'codenib']

def init(phase):
    before = snapshot()
    status_before = subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','-z','-uall'], cwd=REPO)
    result = command(phase, CLI+['codegraph','init',str(REPO),'--agent','codex','--language','python'])
    after = snapshot()
    assert before == after
    assert status_before == subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','-z','-uall'], cwd=REPO)
    save(dict(phase=phase+'-preservation', source_unchanged=True, files=after, git_status=status_before.decode()))
    command(phase+'-status', CLI+['codegraph','status',str(REPO),'--json'])

async def query(client, phase):
    start = time.monotonic()
    result = await client.call_tool('dependency_subgraph', arguments={'symbol':'main_workflow','direction':'dependencies','depth':1,'max_nodes':12,'max_edges':24})
    payload = result.model_dump(mode='json')
    structured = payload.get('structured_content') or {}
    if phase in ('live-after-edit-before-rebuild','live-after-rebuild'):
        assert payload['is_error'] is True, payload
        assert payload.get('structured_content') is None, payload
        message = ' '.join(item.get('text','') for item in payload.get('content',[]))
        assert 'codenib codegraph init' in message and 'restart' in message, payload
    save(dict(phase=phase, seconds=round(time.monotonic()-start,3), nodes=structured.get('nodes'), result=payload))
    return structured

async def fresh_query(phase, expected):
    with (ROOT / (phase+'.stderr')).open('w') as errors:
        async with Client(stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command=PYTHON,args=['-m','codenib','mcp',str(REPO),'--tool-surface','full'], env=env, cwd=ROOT),errlog=errors),mode='auto',cache=None) as client:
            result = await query(client,phase)
            assert any(expected in n['name'] for n in result.get('nodes',[])), result

(REPO/'pyproject.toml').write_text('[project]\nname="workflow-fixture"\nversion="0.0.0"\n')
(REPO/'engine.py').write_text('def compute(values):\n    return sum(values)\n')

for args in (['git','init','-q'],['git','config','user.name','Fixture'],['git','config','user.email','fixture@example.invalid'],['git','config','gc.auto','0'],['git','config','maintenance.auto','false'],['git','add','.'],['git','commit','-qm','fixture']):
    subprocess.run(args,cwd=REPO,check=True,capture_output=True)
(REPO/'engine.py').write_text('def compute(values):\n    return sum(values) - 1\n')
(REPO/'scratch.py').write_text('unfinished = True\n')
init('dirty-first-init')

async def main():
    with (ROOT / 'live-session.stderr').open('w') as errors:
        async with Client(stdio_client(StdioServerParameters(command=PYTHON,args=['-m','codenib','mcp',str(REPO),'--tool-surface','full'],env=env,cwd=ROOT),errlog=errors),mode='auto',cache=None) as client:
            await query(client,'live-initial')
            (REPO/'engine.py').write_text('def compute_v2(values):\n    return sum(values) - 2\n')
            (REPO/'main.py').write_text('from engine import compute_v2\n\ndef main_workflow(values):\n    return compute_v2(values)\n')
            command('edited-old-index-status', CLI+['codegraph','status',str(REPO),'--json'],check=False)
            await query(client,'live-after-edit-before-rebuild')
            init('tracked-edit-init')
            await query(client,'live-after-rebuild')
    await fresh_query('fresh-after-edit','compute_v2')
    (REPO/'helpers.py').write_text('def compute_v3(values):\n    return sum(values) - 3\n')
    (REPO/'main.py').write_text('from helpers import compute_v3\n\ndef main_workflow(values):\n    return compute_v3(values)\n')
    init('created-file-init')
    await fresh_query('fresh-after-create','helpers.py:compute_v3')
    (REPO/'helpers.py').rename(REPO/'pricing.py')
    (REPO/'main.py').write_text('from pricing import compute_v3\n\ndef main_workflow(values):\n    return compute_v3(values)\n')
    init('renamed-file-init')
    await fresh_query('fresh-after-rename','pricing.py:compute_v3')
    (REPO/'engine.py').unlink()
    (REPO/'pricing.py').write_text('def final_compute(values):\n    return sum(values) - 4\n')
    (REPO/'main.py').write_text('from pricing import final_compute\n\ndef main_workflow(values):\n    return final_compute(values)\n')
    init('deleted-file-init')
    await fresh_query('fresh-after-delete','pricing.py:final_compute')
